en.topic_title: Around 66% of Hong Kong upper primary students experience stress from testing overload – survey
en.topic_summary:
Close to 70 percent of upper primary students in Hong Kong say they experience stress brought on by excessive school assessments and testing, a new survey conducted by a local charity and a social work scholar has found.



A total of 5,200 pupils in Primary Four to Six were interviewed in the survey, conducted by Caritas Hong Kong and Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) researcher Moon Law between October and January last year.
